notes.notes: During the Steam Summer Sale (June 22, 2017 until July 5, 2017), gamers who already own the FlatOut Complete Pack can add FlatOut 4: Total Insanity to their library for as low as $9.99 USD! At that price, you gotta have it!

notes.title: Loyalty discount for FlatOut Complete Pack owners!
notes.notes:
Attention FlatOut fans!

For the next 30 days, Strategy First will be offering a 25% loyalty discount on FlatOut 4: Total Insanity for everyone who purchased the FlatOut Complete Pack! This week FlatOut 4: Total Insanity is on sale until Monday June 19th at 15% off, so Complete Pack owners can get a total of 40% off until Monday June 19th!

notes.title: Steam Leaderboards reset
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We had a little technical glitch last night that required us to reset the Steam Leaderboards, which we did this morning. Apologies for that, we wouldn't have done it if it wasn't necessary. Thanks for your understanding!

FlatOut team
